ticket.subject: Template changes not saving
ticket.body_text:
Hello support,

Writing on behalf of Ottervale Software. Every time I edit a project template and press Save, I get 'Something went wrong' and the change is lost.

Our onboarding process is built on these templates, and there is no other way to edit them.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please help us fix this quickly.

Best,
Bruno

label_notes: clean bug (bug-save-error): a core workflow is broken for one customer with no workaround, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
